section_1.title: The Hook: The Speeding Cheetah
section_1.content: Introduce a cheetah sprinting. We know the total distance and total time, but how do we know if it was speeding at a specific micro-moment? Connect average speed (total distance/total time) to the need for a more precise measurement.
section_1.example: A cheetah runs 100 meters in 5 seconds. Average speed is 20 m/s, but what was its speed exactly at the 2-second mark?

section_2.title: Visualizing the Slope of a Secant Line
section_2.content: Use a position-time graph (parabolic curve). Draw a secant line passing through two points (t1, t2). Explain that the slope of this line represents the 'Average Rate of Change'.
section_2.example: A graph showing a blue curve (distance) with a straight red secant line connecting two dots, labeled 'Rise/Run'.

section_3.title: The Limiting Process: Getting Closer
section_3.content: Animate the second point moving closer to the first point. As the interval Δt shrinks toward zero, the secant line transforms. This is the conceptual birth of the tangent line.
section_3.example: Animation: The red secant line rotates and flattens as the second point 'slides' along the curve toward the first point.

section_4.title: Defining the Derivative
section_4.content: Formalize the concept: The derivative is the limit of the average rate of change as Δt approaches 0. Introduce the notation f'(x) as the 'instantaneous slope'.
section_4.example: Mathematical formula: f'(x) = lim(h→0) [f(x+h) - f(x)] / h, overlaid on the static tangent line.

section_5.title: Application & Wrap-up
section_5.content: Summarize how the derivative is a 'magnifying glass' for change. Revisit the cheetah: the slope of the tangent line at exactly t=2 gives the instantaneous speed.
section_5.example: Display the final tangent line at t=2 on the cheetah's graph, labeled 'Instantaneous Velocity: 24 m/s'.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                # Shift right side slightly to the right
                x = 2.0 + j * 0.8
